title: Candle Holder
body:
"A dyeable candle holder for all your candle holding needs."

Description

The Candle Holder can be bought at the Monstrous Manor or from Halloween Poppers. Its grey, smooth on the bottom, and when there is a candle above it, the candle will attach to the candle holder

Trivia

  • Has a fancy variant called the Fancy Candle Holder, which is bigger and has a darker grey.
  • Can be dyed
